1.t: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. And He is Most Capable of everything
1.tr: Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku Wa-huwa 'alaa kulli shai-in qadeer

2.t: ˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving
2.tr: Allazee khalaqal mawta walhayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; Wa-huwal 'azeezul ghafoor

3.t: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws
3.tr: Allazee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa maa taraa fee khalqir rahmaani min tafaawut farji'il basara hal taraa min futoor

4.t: Then look again and again—your sight will return frustrated and weary
4.tr: Summar ji'il basara karrataini yanqalib ilaikal basaru khaasi'anw Wa-huwa haseer

5.t: And indeed, We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps, and made them ˹as missiles˺ for stoning ˹eavesdropping˺ devils, for whom We have also prepared the torment of the Blaze
5.tr: Wa-laqad zaiyannas samaaa'ad dunyaa bimasaa-beeha Wa-ja'alnaahaa rujoomal lish-shayaateeni Wa-a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabas sa'eer

6.t: Those who disbelieve in their Lord will suffer the punishment of Hell. What an evil destination
6.tr: Wa-lillazeena kafaroo bi-rabbihim 'azaabu jahannama Wa-bi'sal maseer

7.t: When they are tossed into it, they will hear its roaring as it boils over
7.tr: Izaaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqanw Wa-hiya tafoor

8.t: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is cast into it, its keepers will ask them, “Did a warner not come to you?”
8.tr: Takaadu tamayyazu minal ghaizz kullamaaa ulqiya feehaa fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhaaa alam ya'tikum nazeer

9.t: They will reply, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has revealed nothing. You are extremely astray.’”
9.tr: Qaaloo balaa qad jaaa'anaa nazeerun fakazzabnaa Wa-qulnaa maa nazzalal laahu min shai-in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer

10.t: And they will lament, “If only we had listened and reasoned, we would not be among the residents of the Blaze!”
10.tr: Wa-qaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u aw na'qilu maa kunnaa feee as-haabis sa'eer

11.t: And so they will confess their sins. So away with the residents of the Blaze

12.t: Indeed, those in awe of their Lord without seeing Him will have forgiveness and a mighty reward
12.tr: Innal lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bilghaibi lahum maghfiratunw Wa-ajrun kabeer

13.t: Whether you speak secretly or openly—He surely knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart
13.tr: Wa-asirroo qawlakum awij haroo bih; innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor

14.t: How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware
14.tr: Alaa ya'lamu man khalaqa Wa-huwal lateeful khabeer

15.t: He is the One Who smoothed out the earth for you, so move about in its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection ˹of all˺
15.tr: Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul arda zaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa Wa-kuloo mir rizqih; Wa-ilaihin nushoor

16.t: Do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you up as it quakes violently
16.tr: A-amintum man fis samaaa'i ai yakhsifa bi-kumul arda fa-izaa hiya tamoor

17.t: Or do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not unleash upon you a storm of stones. Only then would you know how ˹serious˺ My warning was
17.tr: Am amintum man fis samaaa'i ai yursila 'alaikum haasiba fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer

18.t: And certainly those before them denied ˹as well˺, then how severe was My response
18.tr: Wa-laqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fakaifa kaana nakeer

19.t: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading and folding their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. Indeed, He is All-Seeing of everything
19.tr: Awalam yaraw ilat tairi fawqahum saaaffaatinw Wa-yaqbidn; maa yumsikuhunna illaar rahmaan; innahoo bikulli shai-im baseer

20.t: Also, which ˹powerless˺ force will come to your help instead of the Most Compassionate? Indeed, the disbelievers are only ˹lost˺ in delusion
20.tr: Amman haazal lazee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir rahmaan; inil kaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor

21.t: Or who is it that will provide for you if He withholds His provision? In fact, they persist in arrogance and aversion ˹to the truth˺
21.tr: Amman haazal lazee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah; bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwinw Wa-nufoor

22.t: Who is ˹rightly˺ guided: the one who crawls facedown or the one who walks upright on the Straight Path
22.tr: Afamai yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaaa ammany yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siratim mustaqeem

23.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is the One Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.”
23.tr: Qul huwal lazee ansha-akum Wa-ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon

24.t: ˹Also˺ say, “He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.”
24.tr: Qul huwal lazee zara-akum fil ardi Wa-ilaihi tuhsharoon

25.t: ˹Still˺ they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
25.tr: Wa-yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

26.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only sent with a clear warning.”
26.tr: Qul innamal 'ilmu 'indal laahi Wa-innamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen

27.t: Then when they see the torment drawing near, the faces of the disbelievers will become gloomy, and it will be said ˹to them˺, “This is what you claimed would never come.”
27.tr: Falaammaa ra-awhu zulfatan seee'at wujoohul lazeena kafaroo Wa-qeela haazal lazee kuntum bihee tadda'oon

28.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Consider this: whether Allah causes me and those with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
28.tr: Qul ara'aytum in ahlaka-niyal laahu Wa-mam ma'iya aw rahimanaa famai yujeerul kaafireena min 'azaabin aleem

29.t: Say, “He is the Most Compassionate—in Him ˹alone˺ we believe, and in Him ˹alone˺ we trust. You will soon know who is clearly astray.”
29.tr: Qul huwar rahmaanu aamannaa bihee Wa-'alaihi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen

30.t: Say, “Consider this: if your water were to sink ˹into the earth˺, then who ˹else˺ could bring you flowing water?”
30.tr: Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maaa'ukum ghawran famai ya'teekum bimaaa'im ma'een
